name: Starfall Isle — site artifact sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Starfall Isle is a small floating blue/gold spired settlement with crystal-like hanging underside. Source map gives skyline and mood but does not resolve an interior plan, traversal or individual building modules. Hidden layout inference: Keep its clustered spires as a distant backdrop to one accessible star court/shrine and a sky arrival overlook. A short garden path links those focal areas; avoid inventing a whole second palace or huge unwalkable rear city merely from the tiny drawing. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "S05-ARTIFACT-001 — Starfall Isle — site artifact sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".
